item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME
Last Update: 2:33 am EDT Sep 10, 2026


Small Craft Advisory

Thursday: WSW wind 20 to 25 kt decreasing to 15 to 20 kt in the afternoon. Showers likely, mainly before 7am. Areas of fog before 7am. Seas 7 ft subsiding to 5 ft.

Thursday Night: NW wind around 10 kt. Partly cloudy. Seas 3 to 4 ft.

Friday: NW wind around 10 kt becoming WSW in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Friday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Clear. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Sunny. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Saturday Night: SSW wind around 10 kt. Partly cloudy. Seas around 2 ft.

Sunday: S wind 10 to 15 kt. A chance of showers between 10am and 2pm. Seas around 3 ft.

Sunday Night: S wind 10 to 15 kt becoming W after midnight. Mostly cloudy. Seas around 3 ft.

Monday: NNW wind around 10 kt becoming WNW in the afternoon. Mostly sunny. Seas around 3 ft.
